# Independent brief evaluation — 2026-10-16

These are fictional, locally authored QA inputs, not customer sites or an approval to publish. The authoring agent receives one case's `brief.md`, `source.md` and `content-inventory.json`, the current skill, and a freshly fetched live contract. Do not give it the old demos, their implementation or the reviewer notes as an answer template.

## Cases

| Case | Audience and single job | Distinguishing visual problem | Assets |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Strunopis | Instrument owner: understand the workshop's approach and prepare observations for a conversation | Material-focused craft page; the instrument is the subject, not a generic service-card grid | One workshop photograph is needed. No approved file or URL exists in this fixture. |
| Półmrok | Curious viewer: navigate an imagined film programme and choose a story to read | Typographic cultural poster plus a useful programme index; no product demo or service funnel | No photographic or video asset is required. |

The briefs deliberately do not name composition recipes, presets, node IDs or an expected widget tree. The implementation should demonstrate selection from the live contract. `source.md` contains the exact approved public copy. Its heading markers identify entries and are not public content. Link destinations are defined in the inventory; no external links, forms, bookings, payments, real contact collection or invented social proof are authorized.

`content-inventory.json` is a **review input**, not a newly invented version of the canonical `monteby-client-content-document`. It records source entries, intended semantic placements, logical occurrence counts and exact anchor links before authoring. Counts describe intended authored uses, not duplicated responsive menu markup. A subsequent canonical ledger must be produced and verified through the existing supported owner, bound to the actual site/page/scope. Do not rename this inventory to v2 or claim a completed content gate from its existence.

No `handoff.json` or composition plan is supplied yet: there is no fresh live contract, selected site profile, page ID or approved Strunopis media in this fixture. The authoring agent must make and explain those decisions rather than inherit a hidden reference answer. Missing tokens or media are explicit pending inputs, not permission to invent URLs, copy global values into literals or reuse Forma's unrelated interior photograph. An initial text-only Strunopis preview may diagnose layout but cannot close its requested material-led visual direction.

## Evaluation sequence

1. Preserve the raw brief and source bytes. Resolve live capabilities and assets; make a page-specific handoff before expanding compositions.
2. Compare every inventory entry, link pair and unique anchor against the expanded candidate. Report unavailable semantic slots rather than dropping or merging copy.
3. Use canonical validation, versioned save/readback and public WordPress/PHP; verify actual font loading and media provenance. Temporary global changes remain the integrator's separate authorization and responsibility.
4. Retain public full-page screenshots at 1440, 834, 390 and 375 px. Check keyboard navigation, no-JS reading, focus, link targets and short/long-copy resilience. Motion is not requested by either brief.
5. A reviewer who did not author the implementation receives the raw brief and public evidence, not the implementer's claimed visual verdict. Review task clarity, hierarchy, rhythm, readability, asset treatment and responsive intent. Record technical and visual results separately.

There is no visual reference, so neither case can earn a reference-based 1:1 score. Valid JSON, no overflow and a completed content ledger do not independently establish premium design. No public page, canonical write, browser test or publication has been performed by the fixture author.

`existing-pages-review.md` is a separate bounded refinement proposal for the two old demos. It is **not** input to either fresh forward test. Prior captures and failed/unfinished evidence remain intact.
